name: Molybdenum ditelluride, Td phase
equilibrium_context: Type-II Weyl semimetal below about 250 K, non-centrosymmetric
summary: Contrasting case to WTe2: the same transition, but thermally rather than field-driven.

driven_states.emergent_property: Transition from the topologically non-trivial Td phase into the centrosymmetric, trivial 1T' phase within less than one picosecond; the signature is a dramatic change of the shear mode at 0.42 THz and the loss of second-harmonic intensity.
driven_states.source: Zhang, Wang, Li, Shi et al., Phys. Rev. X 9, 021036 (2019), doi:10.1103/PhysRevX.9.021036
driven_states.caveat: Here the alternative explanation is not merely conceivable, it is stated in the work itself: the fluence-dependent time-resolved second harmonic approximately coincides with the purely lattice-thermal curve, which the authors record as agreement with a lattice-thermal effect. It is therefore listed as thermal; within the registry the entry serves above all as a contrasting case to the field-driven, non-thermal WTe2 switch. Topology again inferred only via symmetry.

threshold.quantity: fluence range; shear mode amplitude maximal at 1.5, mode disappears at 5

driven_states.measured_quantity: time-resolved second harmonic, coherent phonon spectra

sources: Zhang et al., Phys. Rev. X 9, 021036 (2019), doi:10.1103/PhysRevX.9.021036
gaps: Thermal origin recorded by the authors themselves.
